subject: Re: Invoice routing & payment terms — PO trigger + early-pay option
messages:
From: Alex Brown <abrown@healthstack.com>
To: david_kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Payments Team <payments@healthstack.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial: Invoice routing and terms for pilot

Hi David —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move the Q2 pilot forward but need to align on invoicing and payment terms before we issue a PO. A few constraints on our side:

- Our procurement requires PO-backed invoices for all vendors. PO will be issued once billing entity and payment terms are agreed.
- Corporate prefers Net60 for new vendors, but the payments team can consider Net30/45 if vendor offers an early-pay discount.
- For any EU activity, we need split invoices to our EU subsidiary and the VAT certificate on file.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (1) accept a PO as a trigger for the invoice run, (2) issue split invoices across US/EU entities when needed, and (3) provide an early-pay discount (e.g., 1-2%) for Net30/45?

We would like to close terms this week so procurement can issue the PO.

Thanks,
Alex Brown\Head of Partnerships\HealthStack

From: david_kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Brown <abrown@healthstack.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Invoice routing and terms for pilot

Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes to PO trigger, yes to split invoicing, and we can offer an early-pay incentive. A bit more detail below so Procurement has what they need to issue the PO.

1) PO trigger: We can accept the PO as the invoice trigger. Please include the PO number and the billing contact in the PO text; we'll tie invoices to that PO and route to your payments mailbox.

2) Split invoices / VAT routing: We can generate separate invoice lines (or separate invoice files) for your US entity and EU subsidiary. For the EU invoice we'll need the VAT certificate on file before we issue the first EU invoice. (We can accept the certificate as an attachment to this thread or via your vendor portal.)

3) Terms & early-pay: Standard hosted customers are on Net30. For pilot flexibility we can do Net45 at standard rates, or Net60 conditional on a 10% prepayment/deposit. Alternatively, to help your AR team optimize cash, we can do Net45 with a 1.5% early-pay discount if paid within 15 days of invoice.

Attached: a draft SOW and instructions for PO fields that help our finance team automate routing.

If that sounds reasonable I'll loop in Finance (Kimberly) and our CS lead (Marissa) to finalize the flow.

Best,
David Kim\Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference\mobile: (415) 555-0138

Attachments: SOW_Q2_Redwood_v1.pdf (pdf, 220KB)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-05-11T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice routing and terms for pilot

Hi Alex —

Thanks David. Quick notes from CS/ops perspective so the PO doesn't hit any delays:

- Please specify the service start date on the PO (we'll align invoice start with activation).
- If you want separate files for US and EU invoices, add both legal entity names and billing addresses on the PO; otherwise the PO should indicate "bill-to: EU subsidiary (if applicable)" and include the EU VAT number.
- For split invoices we will create two PDFs and link them to the same PO number. That helps your AR team post payments correctly.

On the early-pay discount: to avoid manual re-invoicing we can apply a discount line item on the invoice at issuance and then accept payment against that net. If HealthStack prefers rebate after payment, note that adds month-end reconciliation.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call with Payments to walk through sample invoice PDFs if helpful.

—Marissa\Director, Customer Success Operations\Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Alex / Team —

From Finance side: we can accept the PO as trigger. A few conditions to close Net60 versus Net45:

- Net60: requires a 10% non-refundable deposit wired to Redwood's bank account prior to the first invoice and completion of vendor onboarding (W9 for US vendors).
- Net45: no deposit required if HealthStack agrees to 1.5% early-pay discount for payment within 15 days, otherwise standard Net30.
- VAT: for EU-billed invoices we require your VAT certificate (attachment in this thread is fine). Once we have it we will apply the EU billing profile and reverse-charge if applicable.

If you send the PO with the billing entity and VAT number today we can set the billing profile and upload the HealthStack VAT cert so the first EU invoice is generated correctly. I've attached our vendor onboarding checklist and W9 requirements.

Kimberly Park\Senior Finance Manager, Billing\Redwood Inference
